lookForward.fits: Sukkot eve in Jerusalem: the holiday begins at 17:52.
lookForward.headline: The holiday begins tonight at 17:52
lookForward.line: In Jerusalem candles are lit forty minutes before sunset, earlier than anywhere else in the country. Sukkahs on every balcony, stone giving back the day’s heat, and a first evening outside without a jumper. Almost.

source.name: Hebcal: Candle lighting times for Jerusalem

onThisDay.fits: 25 September 2018: the fast line from Jerusalem to the airport opened to passengers.
onThisDay.headline: The fast train from Jerusalem set off
onThisDay.line: From Navon station, a hundred metres underground, to the airport in twenty minutes. Free for the first months. A year later it reached Tel Aviv.

source.name: mynet Jerusalem: The fast line opens to passengers
